items.title: Why is the family unit important?
items.explanation: The family is the fundamental and most ancient unit of any society. In Indian society today, there are several types of families — from joint families to nuclear families. Love and dharma are the flower and fruit of family life.

items.title: Understanding Family Types
items.explanation: A joint family consists of several generations living together (grandparents, parents, uncles, aunts), while a nuclear family is limited to a couple and their children or sometimes one parent and children. Indian languages have many terms for relationships like bua, tau, chacha, mausi, nana, nani, which do not always have direct English equivalents.
